findings.reason: an implementing node reading §3 would build or extend machinery that already exists and re-run a landed oracle; §3 and §7 must be collapsed to one gate that cites the receipt, or §3 reduced to a pointer.
findings.text: §3 proposes "saddle vertex as a clip vertex, branch-paired chords, per-branch supports" as a design to build, but the machinery is already on main: SaddleCellWedges (:335), padded_linear_current_moments (:378), _ordered_saddle_wedges (:1487, the branch pairing), traced_saddle_wedges (:2170) and the clip's saddle_vertex argument (separatrix_clip.py:933/1031/1156); §7 itself records the same oracle as already landed (core-side current within 1e-13 of the analytic wedge integral at 110/300/500 cells) while §3's done-when re-runs that oracle at 1e-6 and never cites the landing, so the two sections own the same gate and one of them re-runs delivered work

findings.reason: §8 dispatched as a merge would find nothing to merge and would produce its exact-clip tables over machinery already landed, so the section must be closed or repointed to the exact-clip tables alone, and §5's held-stack premise is stale.
findings.text: §5 states the "held stacks" 0372d3fc and 28a49bcb are "neither merged nor discarded until §2 lands" and §8:595's first action is "Merge the held stacks 0372d3fc and 28a49bcb", but both are already ancestors of main (`git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> main` is true for each; 4551 commits behind main), and main's separatrix_clip.py already carries the arc_tracer/curve_evaluator ordered clip and forward_operator.py already carries the three-mode clip switch — the merge and the clip-default flip are done

reuse_search-1.reason: Section 3 is deferred to converged-forward-solve section 3, whose booking takes saddle support from the null's normal form (lead ruling 2026-10-05); the 6cb5b3e25 decomposition showed the apex wedge does not move the diverted error, so SaddleCellWedges is not reused.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the design extends existing deep modules (the clip in nova/equilibrium/separatrix_clip.py, the moment path in nova/equilibrium/clip_quadrature.py, _profile_support in nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py) and keeps fixed-capacity padded shapes so no new wrapper surface is added.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the plan cites the owning documents by link (uniform-cell-clip-and-coupling owns the unified clip-and-moment path per §4; null-identification-authority and plasma-cell-topology-authority own the reads) and does not fork placement, path resolution, scheduler queries or a state reader.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the plan flips an existing internal mode switch (clip_mode ∈ {chord, exact, chord_cells}, forward_operator.py:2705) and extends existing ledgers, adds no interface family, and §2/§4 name the chord clip's retirement.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §3 designs the saddle-wedge X-point clip and gives it an oracle gate, but that machinery (SaddleCellWedges, traced_saddle_wedges, _ordered_saddle_wedges, padded_linear_current_moments) already exists on main, and §5/§8 treat 0372d3fc and 28a49bcb as unmerged held stacks that are already ancestors of main.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §7 wires the clip's existing saddle_vertex parameter (separatrix_clip.py:933/1031/1156) and §2 rung A restores the existing traced_clip path; neither adds a parallel layer over the machinery.
